infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ride-Book Partner uses your location while you're online so you receive nearby ride requests and riders can track your arrival.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Ride-Book Partner continues using your location in the background while you're online so you receive nearby ride requests.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ride-Book Partner uses the camera to capture your driving licence, vehicle documents, and profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ride-Book Partner accesses your photo library so you can upload your vehicle and licence documents.
